name: openclaw-agent-core
description: Selective vendoring of OpenClaw agent-core, llm-core, and normalization-core for the PDFMuse Agent Host.

vendoredPackages.name: @openclaw/agent-core
vendoredPackages.contents: All non-test source files under src/ (agent loop, agent, types, validation, runtime deps, harness compaction/messages/session utilities).

vendoredPackages.name: @openclaw/normalization-core
vendoredPackages.contents: Only the modules imported by agent-core: cjk-chars, error-coercion, number-coercion, record-coerce, result, string-coerce, utf16-slice.

notVendored: All *.test.ts and *.test-support.ts files (fetch from the upstream commit when running Core contract tests during an upgrade).
OpenClaw Gateway, channels, nodes, plugin loader, SecretRef, workspace config, memory-host-sdk, and every other workspace package.

npmDependencies.name: @openclaw/ai
npmDependencies.reason: Public provider runtime (streamSimple/completeSimple). Its root export re-exports @openclaw/llm-core from the same pinned commit, so llm-core is consumed from npm instead of being vendored (avoids duplicate EventStream class declarations). Matches the workspace version at the pinned commit; MIT; engines node>=22.19.0 satisfied by Electron 44 bundled Node 24.19.0.

npmDependencies.name: typebox
npmDependencies.reason: Public schema library required by agent-core at the pinned commit.

patches.description: Rewrote bare workspace imports inside vendored agent-core files so the sources compile and run inside dist-electron without a pnpm workspace: '@openclaw/llm-core' and '@openclaw/agent-core/src/llm.js' re-exports now point at '@openclaw/ai' (same types from the npm build); '@openclaw/normalization-core/<mod>' points at the vendored '../../normalization-core/src/<mod>.js' (depth-adjusted). No other changes.

verification.blobShaCheck: agent-loop.ts, agent.ts, errors.ts verified against GitHub git blob SHAs at the pinned commit before patching.
